description: Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka - Notice under section 10(3) of the Sri Lanka Electricity Act,No. 20 of 2009 (Amended) issuance of certificate of exemption
reasoning: This gazette contains a legal/regulatory notice from the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka regarding exemptions from licensing requirements under the Sri Lanka Electricity Act. It involves regulatory matters, statutory instruments, and compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
